description: This file defines a custom exception class {@code PolicyNotAccessibleException} used within a policy management context in the project. It models an exception thrown when a policy cannot be accessed due to nonexistence or insufficient permissions. The class includes various factory methods, a builder pattern, and annotations relevant for immutability and JSON parsing.

classes.name: PolicyNotAccessibleException
classes.description: Final class representing a specific runtime exception indicating that a policy is not accessible due to absence or permission issues. It extends {@code DittoRuntimeException} and implements {@code PolicyException}. Provides static methods for instantiation and a builder class for flexible construction. It is annotated as {@code @Immutable} and {@code @JsonParsableException}, aligning with thread-safety and JSON serialization requirements.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for {@code PolicyNotAccessibleException} given a policy ID, enabling fluent construction of the exception with custom properties.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a {@code PolicyNotAccessibleException} from a provided message string and headers, for direct exception creation with a custom message.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs the exception from a JSON object representing error details, incorporating headers. Throws exceptions if required fields are missing or improperly formatted.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated headers while preserving other properties, supporting immutable pattern.
